class ItemStore:
    """Thread-safe in-memory store for items."""

    def __init__(self):
        self._items: Dict[UUID, Item] = {}
        self._lock = Lock()

    def create(self, item_data: ItemCreate) -> Item:
        """Create a new item."""
        item = Item(**item_data.model_dump())
        with self._lock:
            self._items[item.id] = item
